title: Few hours later and there is a lot of progress. Units, pathfinding, animations, resource extraction, building.
author: zebleck

comments.author: zebleck
comments.body: If you have any questions about the workflow let me know, but for now I need to sleep.

replies.author: edoc422
replies.body: I would love to know your workflow! for starters is this html or did use an MCP to use a game engine? I have been able to do some cool things but having very hard time to get it to do visuals well.

replies.author: zebleck
replies.body: This is pure HTML 5 Canvas and a node js server using javascript. No game engine. The visuals are not AI and are a free asset pack (seen here [https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords](https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords) ). What clicked for me was  that I had to tell Claude exactly how the spritesheet is built, then it understood it and could use it effectively.
